excerpt:
Zero-code local proxy that pinpoints the exact UTF-8 byte breaking your LLM prompt cache (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini / Antigravity, llama.cpp/vLLM), tallies wasted dollars, and optionally auto-heals prefixes live. Watch the 15-second kvdiff demo (MP4) Try the demo: npx @drod915/kvdiff --demo npx @drod915/kvdiff --demo Opens pre-seeded with two realistic sessions: - Claude Code + 15 MCP Tools (16 turns): Turn 1 warms the prompt cache at 0%, and Turns 2-13 run at 94% cache hit. On Turn 14, mcp-github reconnects and reorders tool schemas: kvdiff highlights the exact red byte offset ($.tools[9].name, byte 1,670), calculates the wasted cost ($0.38), and shows Turn 15 snapping back to 97% cache hit under --heal. - Antigravity / Gemini 2.5 Pro (5 turns): Catches a volatile timestamp injected into $.systemInstruction.parts[0].text on Turn 4. Record the demo in a terminal with vhs demo/kvdiff.tape. Wrap any coding agent CLI with zero code changes: # Claude Code (Anthropic Messages API) npx @drod915/kvdiff -- claude # Codex CLI / OpenCode (OpenAI Responses & Chat APIs) npx @drod915/kvdiff -- codex # Gemini CLI / Antigravity API workflows (Google Gemini API) npx @drod915/kvdiff -- gemini # Opt-in deterministic tool-schema healing npx @drod915/kvdiff --heal -- claude Or run as a persistent local proxy for Antigravity, Cursor, IDE plugins, or local llama.cpp/vLLM: # Cloud providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini / Antigravity) npx @drod915/kvdiff serve --port 4318 # Local llama.cpp / vLLM KV-cache prefix reuse debugging npx @drod915/kvdiff serve --port 4318 --upstream-local Then point your client base URL: - ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL= - OPENAI_BASE_URL= - GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL= flowchart LR Agent["Coding Agent / IDE
